# The Bounded Observer

Author: Daniel John Murray. ORCID 0009-0005-1794-5945.

The programme studies what an observer can record, read, retain, combine and change. UHL is its operational mathematics of positive records and bounded normalized readings. SIH studies field regularity and concentration in named models. IDA, VCC and other branches are scoped instruments, applications and experiments.

## Current authority

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): claims, evidence, preservation and contribution rules.
- [README.md](README.md): project entrance.
- [LAB.md](LAB.md): active questions, runnable models and the experiment/revision cycle.
- [Project structure](docs/project-structure.md): dependencies and branch relationships.
- [Branch contract](docs/branch-contract.md): operational interface for extensions.
- [Branch registry](registry/branches.json): typed relationships and current evidence.
- [Current capstone](papers/library-2026-10-12/papers/capstone.md): finite operational closure with named premises.
- [Current papers](papers/README.md): supporting papers, amendment and proposed corrections.
- [Publication receipt](papers/PUBLICATION_STATUS_2026-10-13.md): SSRN status and licensing.

## Applications

- [Physical models and SIH](branches/physics/README.md)
- [Adaptation and biology](branches/adaptation/README.md)
- [IDA](branches/ida/README.md)
- [VCC](branches/vcc/README.md)
- [Scientific AI](branches/scientific-ai/README.md)
- [Arithmetic](branches/arithmetic/README.md)
- [Evidence and decisions](branches/evidence-decisions/README.md)

Applications identify their own records, operation class, clock/resources and physical or measurement bridge. A shared interface does not establish missing model premises. Classical branches do not automatically inherit quantum reconstruction.
